items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: He got me the job over there. And I worked over there with him for awhile, and then we left from there and went to a club called the Exclusive Club, which was on --

ctx.x: Mount Pleasant -- that's where he's from. But, he went to school in Charleston, see? And, I remember him from school. In other words, -- we went to the same school together. Okay -- to bring you up to date -- he was working with the Nighthawks. He worked with the Nighthawks for awhile. And then he came to New York, and he got this job at the Yeah Man. And, he knew about me, you know. He got me the job over there. And I worked over there with him for awhile, and then we left from there and went to a club called…
How many were there at this Yeah Man Club?
